selectionGuide.description: A close-up surprised reaction acts as the punchline after a caption describes an obviously predictable consequence.
bestFor: an action followed by the foreseeable result of that action
feigned shock after ignoring an obvious warning
calling out someone who treats a predictable outcome as surprising
avoidWhen: multiple actors or competing choices need separate labels
the setup requires a complex chronology to understand

mechanics.visual: Pikachu's wide-eyed reaction supplies the exaggerated surprise, so the image completes the joke without a second text region.
mechanics.text: Use top to state both the action and its predictable consequence, often as a compact 'does X; X happens' construction.

slots.name: top
slots.hint: the action and its predictable consequence
